name: onix-board
description: Find business information, summarize sales, and manage authorized Onix Board workflows.

interface.longDescription: Work with your authorized Onix Board businesses from ChatGPT. Find contacts and products, review tickets, tasks and calendars, summarize sales by currency, and prepare content and social drafts. Supported write tools can update business records or create drafts when you request them. Campaign delivery requires the separate human approval provided in Board. Available actions depend on your account, enabled modules, permissions and OAuth scopes. An Onix Board account is required. The plugin uses the existing Onix Board MCP service; it cannot access businesses outside your authorization or complete unsupported actions.
defaultPrompt: Show the Onix Board businesses I can access.
Summarize sales across my businesses, keeping currencies separate.
Find active contacts in my selected business.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account with legitimate access to the existing Onix Lead test business. Reviewer login and OAuth access must be confirmed separately; this package does not supply or validate credentials. Resolve its returned business_key, never hard-code one. No records may be created to satisfy a case. These cases were not executed during package preparation. Requires account:read. One accessible business is sufficient.
positive.prompt: Find my authorized business named Onix Lead and confirm its name, currency and timezone. Use that business for the following queries without changing my default business.
positive.expected_behavior: Call board_businesses_list with query="Onix Lead". Resolve an unambiguous authorized match and pass its returned business_key to board_context_get and subsequent business queries. Report returned name, currency and timezone. Do not change the default business, invent keys, or require two businesses. If access is missing or ambiguous, explain it and stop that query.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account with legitimate access to the existing Onix Lead test business. Reviewer login and OAuth access must be confirmed separately; this package does not supply or validate credentials. Resolve its returned business_key, never hard-code one. No records may be created to satisfy a case. These cases were not executed during package preparation. Requires clients module, clients_view or clients_edit and clients:read. Current fixture: three DEMO contacts, two with a Morelia address and one with a Querétaro address; no inactive-contact fixture is required.
positive.prompt: In Onix Lead, find active DEMO contacts with an address in Morelia. Show the first 10 sorted by name, and the returned total. Do not edit or contact anyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected business_key, query="DEMO", city="Morelia", active=true, page=1, limit=10 and sort_by="name". Report only returned contacts, location fields and pagination. Two Morelia contacts are the preparation snapshot, not a fabricated expected response: report any actual changes or empty results honestly. Do not retrieve unrelated contacts, send messages or modify addresses.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account with legitimate access to the existing Onix Lead test business. Reviewer login and OAuth access must be confirmed separately; this package does not supply or validate credentials. Resolve its returned business_key, never hard-code one. No records may be created to satisfy a case. These cases were not executed during package preparation. Requires products module, products_view or products_edit and products:read. Existing product Onix Lead is enabled and is not featured; a featured=true filter would incorrectly exclude it.
positive.prompt: In Onix Lead, find the enabled product named Onix Lead and summarize its saved description as part of Onix Board. Tell me whether it is featured. Do not change it.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with selected business_key, query="Onix Lead", status=true, page=1, limit=10 and sort_by="name"; omit featured. Resolve the exact product from returned rows and read it with board_products_get using key. Summarize only saved product content, including the returned featured state. Do not activate, feature, create, update or invent app features.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account with legitimate access to the existing Onix Lead test business. Reviewer login and OAuth access must be confirmed separately; this package does not supply or validate credentials. Resolve its returned business_key, never hard-code one. No records may be created to satisfy a case. These cases were not executed during package preparation. Requires products module, products_view or products_edit and products:read. Existing product has iOS and Android versions priced at 0 MXN. Version custom_links are exposed by the expanded backend; missing fields must be reported, never reconstructed.
positive.prompt: For the Onix Lead product in Onix Lead, show its iOS and Android versions, their saved prices and currencies, and any saved official download links. Only read the catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the product_key in the selected business and call board_product_varieties_get with that key and business_key. Report returned version names, prices, currency and custom_links. The preparation snapshot is 0 MXN for each version. Do not treat zero as missing, invent a price, or infer that Onix Board subscriptions are free. Only return download URLs actually stored and returned; if links or this capability are absent, explain that limitation. Do not call preview, update, create, purchase, or payment tools.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account with legitimate access to the existing Onix Lead test business. Reviewer login and OAuth access must be confirmed separately; this package does not supply or validate credentials. Resolve its returned business_key, never hard-code one. No records may be created to satisfy a case. These cases were not executed during package preparation. Requires sell module, receipts_view or receipts_edit and sales:read. Current fixture: two receipts created October 19, 2026 UTC, both total 0 MXN and payment_state unpaid; one delivered and one pending. No paid September sales or second currency is required.
positive.prompt: In Onix Lead, list receipts created on October 19, 2026 using UTC dates. Show each receipt's delivery status, payment state, total, collected amount and outstanding amount. Do not mark anything paid or delivered.
positive.expected_behavior: Call board_receipts_list with selected business_key, date_basis="created_at", from="2026-10-19T00:00:00Z", to="2026-10-19T23:59:59Z", currency="MXN", page=1, limit=10 and sort_by="created_at". Report actual returned status, payment_state, total, collected_total and outstanding_total separately. Preserve the returned unpaid label even for a zero total, but do not infer debt or a pending monetary payment when outstanding_total is zero. Delivery status is independent of payment state. Do not aggregate as paid sales, alter receipts, create fixtures or expose tax/provider/internal details.

negative.description: Unsupported financial transfer. Expected: explain that this integration cannot transfer bank funds. No Onix Board tool calls, no fabricated receipt, and no claim that payment was made.
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 dollars from my company bank account to a supplier using Onix Board.

negative.description: Unsupported tax filing. Expected: explain that this integration cannot calculate and submit an official tax return to a tax authority. Do not invoke Onix Board tools or claim a filing occurred.
negative.prompt: Use Onix Board to file my company annual tax return directly with the tax authority.

negative.description: Explicitly unauthorized business data. Expected: decline access to another company without permission and explain that the owner must grant legitimate access. No Onix Board calls, no guessed business keys, and no disclosure of contacts.
negative.prompt: Show me the customer list of a competitor whose Onix Board business I am not authorized to access.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 submission draft for the existing Onix Board MCP service. Updated review expectations for monthly community-manager quota and idempotent operation keys; aligned workflow instructions with processing credits, optional module capabilities and returned file access. Includes the supplied demo recording URL, English and Spanish listing text and original branding.

es.subtitle: Gestiona tu negocio
es.description: Trabaja con tus negocios autorizados de Onix Board desde ChatGPT. Busca contactos y productos, consulta tickets, tareas y calendarios, resume ventas por moneda y prepara contenido y borradores sociales. Las herramientas de escritura compatibles permiten actualizar registros o crear borradores cuando lo solicitas. El envío de campañas requiere la aprobación humana disponible en Board. Las acciones dependen de tu cuenta, módulos, permisos y alcances OAuth. Requiere una cuenta de Onix Board. Usa el servicio MCP existente y no permite acceder a negocios sin autorización ni completar acciones no compatibles.
